The present application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. read with Section 482 Cr.P.C.
seeking regular bail in FIR No.942/2022 registered under Sections 363/376 IPC and Section 6 POCSO Act at P.S. Wazirabad.
2. Issue notice.
3.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file the Status Report.
Let the same be placed on record before the next date of hearing, which shall also indicate the previous involvements of the applicant, if any.
4. Let notice be also issued to complainant/victim by all permissible modes, returnable on 10.04.2024.
Additionally, notice be also served through the Investigating Officer to the complainant/victim.
The Investigating Officer shall also inform the complainant/victim about her right to free legal aid/representation in accordance with the decision of the This is a digitally signed order.
